agreementTitle: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING & SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT

partyA.name: Apex Digital Solutions Ltd
partyA.address: The Promenade, General Mathenge Dr, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya

partyB.name: Savannah Logistics Kenya Ltd
partyB.address: Kilindini Port View Plaza, 3rd Floor, Moi Avenue, Mombasa, Kenya

purpose: This Agreement establishes a formal commercial framework wherein Party A shall design, engineer, and maintain a Next.js Cloud Dispatch Platform and automated M-Pesa transaction engine for Party B across its East African logistics fleet.
obligations:
1. SCOPE OF SERVICES: Party A shall deliver production code, maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS/Supabase, and provide technical support with guaranteed 99.9% availability.
2. REMUNERATION: Party B shall pay the total contract value of KES 1,200,000 across agreed milestone tranches within 14 days of invoice submission.
3. CONFIDENTIALITY: Each party agrees to treat proprietary software, customer databases, and commercial trade secrets with strict confidentiality.
4. GOVERNING LAW: This Agreement shall be interpreted and enforced under the Laws of the Republic of Kenya.
